senses.gloss:
Nṛpakīrticandrikā
jy. on Sobhabazaar Raj family members of Calcutta. by Rājakiśoragupta. Vaṅgīya p. 265 (inc.).
--C. by a. himself. Vaṅgīya p. 265.
--C. Dīpikā by Ānandacandradāsa. Vaṅgīya p. 265 (inc.).

Nṛpagambhinīpraśaṃsā
(Beg. A setorAsumeroH). in 24 verses. Adyar D. IV. 3086. Extr. p.. 383-4.

Nṛpatinītigarbhitavṛtta
account of events after Aurangazeb's death; by Lakṣmīpati. Ben. 33. IO. 3986. Sūcīpattra 9.

Nṛpabhūṣaṇī
mentioned by Rāmānandatīrtha in his Yathārthamañjarī. L. 1017.

Nṛpavaṃśāvali
by Bhāratī Kṛṣṇatīrtha. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 44.

Nṛpavilāsakāvya
America 2123. R. A. Sastri II. p. 223.
--by Rāma, son of Lakṣmaṇa. Bd. 412. BORI. 412 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XIII. i. 352.
--by Śivarāma, son of Kṛṣṇarāma; written for his brother Keśavarāma.
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 58. IM. 43. RASB. VII. 5456. Stein 69. Extr. 285. Trav. Uni. 10040.
--written under the influence of Naiṣadhīya. by Sitārāma Bhaṭṭa Parvaṇīkar. Ms. in Jaipur.
For a note see Prabhakara Sastri, AIOC. Summaries XXVII. p. 85.

Nṛpaśekhara Kathānaka
forming part of Dvādaśavratakathā. BORI. 586A of 1895-98. Peters. VI. p. 119 (no. 586A). [Page187-b]

Nṛpāvalī
or Rājāvalī. ascribed to Kṣemendra, ref. by Kalhaṇa in Rājataraṅgiṇī, I. 13.
See Life an. works of Kṣemendra. Poona Ori. XVII. p. 30.

Nṛpodanta
in 286 verses. a. account of ancient an. modern dynasties of India, prob. translated into Sanskrit from a. English manual. Bühler 559.
--by Nārāyaṇa Paṇḍita. BL. 67.
--by Mādhavācārya. BORI. 169 of 1866-68.
